tools.name: macro-intelligence_central-bank-rate-compare
tools.description: Compare supplied policy rates across countries and banks. Missing previous rates leave change blank rather than inventing values. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/macro-intelligence/central-bank-rate-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
